question.text:
The reactivity of compound Z with different halogens under appropriate conditions is given below:


The observed pattern of electrophilic substitution can be explained by

options.text: The steric effect of the halogen
The steric effect of the tert-butyl group
The electronic effect of the phenolic group
The electronic effect of the tert-butyl group

solution.text: The reason is the steric hindrance of the tetra-butyl group which is attached to the benzene ring. That is why, the reactivity of compound Z with different halogens under the appropriate condition and electro-negativity of the halogens is Cl2 >Br2>I2
